title: We Don't Judge Canada by Its Gross Debt
standfirst: Gross debt to GDP ratio is over-rated as the key indicator for fiscal soundness. In this report, we explain why a gross debt ratio, least of all the “250% debt to GDP” slogan, should be retired and cannot carry the debt-sustainability verdict.
